card.name: Start of 'Symptomatic' after a sentence
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word 'Symptomatic' (Sym-/sym-) starting a new sentence or phrase in dosing and overdose text. It also fires weakly on a few dose-line points such as a closing parenthesis, 'as' before 'needed', or 'mg' after a number.

modes.label: Sym- of symptomatic
modes.description: The opening piece of 'Symptomatic' at the start of a sentence about treatment or response.
modes.example: Adequate hydration.<< Sym>>ptomatic treatment as necessary.

modes.label: Dose-line fillers
modes.description: Small dosing words or marks in a dose instruction, such as 'as' before 'needed' or 'mg' after a number.
modes.example: One or two tablets every four hours<< as>> needed.

card.writes: It promotes words like attacks, complic and crisis, suggesting it pushes toward medical-event terms.
card.plain: It lights up on the start of the word 'symptomatic' in treatment and dosing sentences.
